_instructions: Copy this file to config/config.json and replace every value below. Then run: python code/01_cohort_and_definitions.py

_notes.timezone: the IANA timezone your hospital is in, e.g. US/Central. Not UTC, even though CLIF stores timestamps in UTC: this decides which calendar year an admission or a death falls in
_notes.project_root: the folder this repository is in
_notes.hospital_ids: every hospital_id that appears in clif_adt for your decedents, written exactly as it appears there. 01_cohort_and_definitions.py stops if the cohort contains an id not listed here, or if a listed id has no row in config/hospital_crosswalk.yaml. A listed id that contributes no decedents is a warning.
